description: This file defines the VulnerabilitiesController class, which handles API endpoints for managing vulnerabilities, including creating, updating, retrieving, deleting, and generating remediations for vulnerabilities in a web application.

classes.name: VulnerabilitiesController
classes.description: Controller class providing REST API endpoints for vulnerability management, including CRUD operations and remediation generation.

methods.name: CreateOne
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new vulnerability, assigns creator, logs audit, and saves to database.

methods.name: UpdateOne
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing vulnerability identified by id.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of vulnerabilities with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a specific vulnerability by id, including related entities.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a vulnerability by id, with audit logging.

methods.name: PutRemediation
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to generate remediation instructions for a vulnerability using AI service, sends notification, and enqueues message.
